title: Measuring Inter-group Agreement on zSlice Based General Type-2 Fuzzy Sets
reasoning: The paper introduces a novel fuzzy set measure to quantify inter-group agreement on perceptions of linguistic terms (e.g., in Quality of Life questionnaires). While Quality of Life can have ethical dimensions, the paper's core contribution and focus are on the technical method for measuring agreement on these perceptions, rather than an evaluation or benchmarking of religion, morals, or ethics themselves.
